parts.name: maid_body
parts.notes: Complete upper costume isolated; lower skirt is cropped and body edges are partially truncated by atlas bounds.

parts.name: back_hair
parts.notes: Rear bob layer matches the rounded hair mass; maid headband is separate.

parts.name: neck_face
parts.notes: Blank face base with ears and neck; facial features are supplied separately.

parts.name: front_hair
parts.notes: Front fringe and side locks correspond, though the atlas hair silhouette differs slightly from the dressed reference.

parts.name: maid_headband
parts.notes: Arched white ruffle headband; much of its inner opening is transparent.

parts.name: visible_eye
parts.notes: Single visible eye; target is the character's image-right eye, with perspective and eyelid shape differences.

parts.name: neck_bow
parts.notes: Large teal neck bow; target placement is partly occluded by the collar and bodice.

parts.name: hair_clip
parts.notes: Cross-shaped metallic hairpin; target position is on the image-right side fringe.

parts.name: mouth
parts.notes: Small smiling mouth isolated; target expression has a slightly broader smile and is partly softened by shading.
